p.note: If the module reports +HTTPDROP:0,1460 during data reception, it indicates that the receive buffer is full, resulting in data drop. Data loss will subsequently lead to parsing errors in the following reception process. Check whether the current baud rate is too low and affecting data interaction. If applicable, increase the baud rate to 115200 bps or 230400 bps (baud rate higher than 9600 bps automatically disables the module from entering PSM). After the HTTP function is completed, switch back to a lower baud rate to restore the PSM-enabled state.
